crossRefs.note: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman.
I said, “Oh that I had wings like a dove! Then I would fly away, and be at rest.
Behold, then I would wander far off. I would lodge in the wilderness.”
Woe is me, that I live in Meshech, that I dwell among the tents of Kedar!
My soul has had her dwelling too long with him who hates peace.
Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men; that I might leave my people, and go from them! For…

translations.web: It is better to dwell in a desert land, than with a contentious and fretful woman.
translations.bsb: Better to live in the desert than with a contentious and ill-tempered wife.
translations.kjv: It is better to dwell in the wilderness, than with a contentious and an angry woman.
translations.asv: It is better to dwell in a desert land, Than with a contentious and fretful woman.
